uat.doc.generated: Generated by `npm run uat:trace` from the implementation plan and the titles of the tests; do not edit by hand. A criterion is covered when a live (not skipped) test title carries its id. A story with the status DONE, DONE_PENDING_ENV or DONE_UNCONFIRMED in `docs/story-status.json` fails the gate when one of its ids is not covered; a DONE_PENDING_ENV or DONE_UNCONFIRMED story may declare the ids that only an external system can prove (field externalChecks).

uatev.doc.title: UAT evidence by screen and requirement
uatev.doc.generated: Generated by `npm run uat:evidence` from `screen_catalog.json`, `traceability.json`, `test_cases.json` and the run store `docs/uat-run-results.json`; do not edit by hand. `docs/UAT-COVERAGE.md` is the other half: it covers the acceptance criteria of the stories by the titles of the tests that exist; this document covers the screens and the requirements by the results of tests that were run.
uatev.doc.screens: Screens complete: {complete} of {total} ({percent} percent); screens with no test of the design: {gaps}.
uatev.doc.rows: Requirement rows complete: {complete} of {total} ({requirements} requirements); by state: {states}.
uatev.doc.rule: A row is PASS only when every test it names has a recorded PASS with its evidence (when it ran, the build, the schema version, the hash of the dataset, the request ids and a link to the evidence). FAIL, SKIPPED and NOT_RUN never count as PASS; a PASS without its evidence is UNPROVEN; a row without any known test is a GAP; WAIVED needs an approved waiver with an owner, a reason and an expiry that has not passed.
uatev.doc.critical: Critical tests with a PASS: {pass} of {total} ({percent} percent). A waiver never counts as a pass here.
uatev.doc.noGaps: Every screen names at least one test.
